events.to: Florian Drummond, shipper; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Booking confirmation DL-3355. Collection today 17 April, window 09:00-11:00, tail-lift vehicle, one pallet cradle (motor scooter). Carried by a subcontracted haulier on behalf of Nettlebank Arc Logistics. The driver completes a condition report with the shipper before loading. Haulier contact details are on the attached job sheet.
My parcel DL-64004 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

Driver arrived 15:10. Window was 9 to 11. No call, no message. He speaks no English. I don't speak his language. He had no translation app and my phone has no signal in the yard. No condition report produced or signed. Scooter went over on the tail-lift while he was loading it. Left side panel dented, mirror snapped off, headlamp rim bent. Photos taken on the lift, timestamped 15:26. He strapped it and drove off.

Thank you for your message. Nettlebank Arc Freight planner arranges transport with independent hauliers and is not party to the handling of the goods. Damage during loading is a matter between the shipper and the haulier. The haulier's details are on your job sheet.
Route plan for depot HL-9 published for Tuesday. 37 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
DL-3355. Haulier: three calls, two texts, one email since Tuesday. Nothing back. Nettlebank Arc took my booking and my money. Who is dealing with this.

DL-3355: the shipper, Florian Drummond, reports damage to the scooter during loading on 17 April, a collection more than four hours outside the window, and no condition report. He has had no reply from the haulier. Which team owns a damage report on this collection, and has an incident report been filed with the haulier?
Route plan for depot WX-6 published for Wednesday. 30 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

events.to: Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk; Delivery investigations, Nettlebank Arc Logistics
events.body: Our position is unchanged. This was a brokered collection and the liability is the haulier's. Please tell Mr Drummond to pursue the haulier and close your case. Do not open a carrier claim on a brokered job.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
DL-32056 rebooked for Friday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

Freight planner copied us in. We do not agree with them. DL-3355 was booked and invoiced by Nettlebank Arc and the confirmation promises a condition report that does not exist. Until it is decided whether this is a carrier claim, do not tell the shipper to pursue the haulier and do not close anything. We have not opened a case; that needs sign-off from the freight manager, which we have asked for. No timescale yet.

Day four. Scooter reached the buyer yesterday, damaged as photographed. Buyer wants a third off the price. Haulier still silent. Freight planner says not them. One question, yes or no: does Nettlebank Arc accept responsibility. If the answer is no, or no answer, I file in the small claims court on Monday naming Nettlebank Arc and your desk. The photos and this whole thread also go on every freight forum I can find so the next person knows what they're booking. Answer today.
